classification: EXPERIMENTAL PROTOCOL. Not PAPER-FAITHFUL. Authorizes no training and no seed spend; it fixes WHAT any authorized run must be.
decided_by: PI, 2026-09-26: make 4v4 the canonical reference recipe and bring 2v2 and the FINAL 6v6 pipeline into alignment with it. Retire the old 2v2 SAPPO lineage from the cross-scale suite without deleting it.
measured_from: CROSS_SCALE_METHODOLOGY_IDENTITY_AUDIT.json -- the 4v4 values below were read off the loaded 4v4 checkpoints and the frozen 4v4 dataset manifest, not copied from prose.
WHY_4V4_IS_THE_REFERENCE: It is the only scale whose full lineage exists and whose Separated arm has a confirmatory PASS. Its scientific recipe is therefore not to be changed to accommodate the other scales; the other scales converge onto it.
CANONICAL_LINEAGE: 1M base specialist (anchor OFF) -> entity-repair continuation -> split pi_D (200k, N' teacher) -> CLOSEST_DEFENDS dataset (entities + roles) -> distillation -> evaluation

sappo_anchor.note: sappo_anchor_lambda is 0.10 by PPOConfig default at every scale and is NOT the gate; do not read it as evidence either way

split_defender_stage.n_prime_teacher: reused exactly -- loss CE(macro,GO_TO)+CE(waypoint,w_N'), lambda 0.1 -> 0.0 decaying 50k..150k, cadence 4, DEFEND-role + alive + decision-eligible gating

dataset_collection.acting: split composite on Pole A, pi_B on Pole B; recorded in the manifest

distillation.schedule: 20 epochs, batch 256, Adam lr 3e-4, grad-norm clip 1.0, no weight decay, no early stopping, terminal weights only
distillation.one_dataset_per_scale: every sharing arm at a scale consumes the SAME frozen manifest

evaluation.gate: mean>0 AND LCB95>0 on BOTH poles

ALLOWED_TO_DIFFER: seed blocks (fresh and disjoint per scale, allocated via experiments/seed_registry.py)
tensor dimensions that follow mechanically from N

HISTORICAL_VS_SUITE_ARTIFACTS.the_key_distinction: The FINAL repaired artifacts enter the suite, not the historical ones that happen to share a scale.

2v2.suite_artifacts: NONE YET -- to be built (fresh certification first)
2v2.why: anchor ON and 1.5M steps; both differ from the canonical recipe
2v2.retained: SAPPO V1 remains a valid finding and provenance in its own right. Nothing is deleted. It simply no longer supplies the cross-scale suite's 2v2 teachers.
2v2.legacy_dataset_not_suite: TEACHER_DISTILLATION_DATASET.json (no allocator, no entity tensors, no roles)

4v4.status: REFERENCE -- do not change its scientific recipe

6v6.suite_artifacts: PENDING -- the FINAL repaired outputs of SCHOOL_PC_6V6_LOCKED_PIPELINE.json (pi_A/pi_B c2_entity_repair finals, pi_D split_defend_k1_v1 final). Verified absent on disk 2026-09-26.
6v6.why_the_base_is_still_usable: those historical specialists already satisfy two fixed facts of the canonical recipe -- anchor OFF and a 1M foundation -- so they are legitimate WARM-START BASES for the entity-repair continuation. They are not themselves suite teachers.
6v6.legacy_dataset_not_suite: TEACHER_DISTILLATION_6V6_DATASET.json (collected from the unrepaired specialists, no allocator, no entity tensors, no roles)
6v6.consequence: no 6v6 base restart from zero is required

STAGE_IMPLEMENTATIONS_required.appended_by: PI, 2026-09-26: configuration identity is not enough -- two scales could report the same values through different implementations. Pin the implementation path too. Appended before any run was attested against the earlier version of this record.
STAGE_IMPLEMENTATIONS_required.rule: Each stage MUST resolve to the SAME module at 2v2, 4v4 and 6v6. Team size is an argument, never a separate module. A module whose name encodes a scale, or which hardcodes a module-level team-size constant, is a per-scale fork and fails this requirement.

specialist_trainer_impl.note: SUPPORTED_TEAM_SIZES=(2,4,6); the pole-certification gate is unchanged, so an accepted --team-size is not permission to train

entity_repair_impl.note: same module; --entity-repair-enabled is a flag, not a fork

allocator_impl.note: k=N/2 default with an explicit k override; scale-agnostic

dataset_collector_impl.note: generalized 2026-09-26 (git mv from collect_suite_distillation_states_4v4.py); --team-size (2,4,6), all paths and k derived from it

distillation_impl.note: --team-size (2,4,6); legacy n==2 dataset routing, n==2 loader and the 2v2 Share-Encoder reuse shortcut all removed 2026-09-26

crossover_evaluator_impl.note: generalized 2026-09-26; --team-size (2,4,6). The forked eval_suite_sharing_crossover_4v4.py is retained ONLY until the in-flight Share-Macro run finishes, then deleted -- see OPEN_ITEMS

separated_crossover_impl.note: --team-size (2,4,6); the N != 2 Pole-B overlay branch was removed 2026-09-26 after verifying pole_B_genome(2) has an empty overlay and installing it leaves all 36 resolved profile fields identical

bootstrap_impl.note: one bootstrap for every delta at every scale

fork_smells_that_fail: a module-level N_AGENTS / AGENTS constant fixed to one team size
a team-size choices tuple that omits a suite scale
an `if n == 2` (or any team-size) branch that changes methodology rather than a derived dimension
STAGE_IMPLEMENTATIONS_required.allowed_to_differ: only N, k, seeds, artifact paths, and tensor dimensions that follow mechanically from N

IDENTITY_ATTESTATION_required.when: as a preflight after the shared runners are generalized, and again before any suite claim
IDENTITY_ATTESTATION_required.rule: every row except N, k, seeds, paths and mechanically-derived tensor dimensions must match across scales
IDENTITY_ATTESTATION_required.unknown_is_not_match: a missing run_config.json means UNKNOWN, never 'same config'. Settings are read from the loaded checkpoint/runtime object, or the attestation fails closed.

two_layers.layer_1_configuration_semantics: the rows above, read from loaded checkpoints and frozen dataset manifests
two_layers.layer_2_implementation_path: STAGE_IMPLEMENTATIONS_required -- every stage resolves to the same module, pinned by sha256, at all three scales
two_layers.attested_requires: BOTH layers pass. Layer 1 alone can pass while two scales reach the same numbers through different code.

NOT_AUTHORIZED_BY_THIS_RECORD: any training run or seed spend
deleting or rewriting the SAPPO V1 records or the historical 6v6/2v2 artifacts
changing the 4v4 scientific recipe to accommodate another scale
retuning the N' teacher schedule, cadence or formula
restarting the 6v6 base specialists from zero
treating a legacy dataset as a suite dataset
